claims.statement: A DTV stay of 180 days can be extended once per entry for up to 180 additional days (360 continuous days total) at Thai Immigration for 1,900 THB.

Thai Immigration requires form TM.7, passport copies, proof of 500,000 THB held for at least 30 days, proof of category activity, proof of residence, TM.30 receipt, and prior TM.47 copies for a DTV extension.
DTV holders must file a 90-day report (TM.47) if staying over 90 consecutive days, and do not need a re-entry permit to leave and re-enter Thailand.
